name: waffle-grid
title: Waffle Grid
description: A 10x10 waffle grid rendering "N of 100" as countable filled cells with a bold readout and caption.
question: How big is this share of the whole, really?
whenToUse: Making a single percentage feel tangible — one share of one whole, where counting units beats reading a number.
antiUse: Not for comparing several shares, time trends, or non-percentage values — use rank bars or a distribution bar instead.
props: value: number (0-100 cells filled); color? (default seriesColor(0)); caption: string
